name: Aquaguard Enrich Neo
summary: The Aquaguard Neo RO+UV 2X is a premium 9-stage water purifier with NanoPore RO 2X , UV e-Boiling , and 3-in-1 Active Copper Technology . It removes harmful contaminants while enriching water with Copper, Calcium, and Magnesium, offering safe, healthy drinking water with a 2-year filter life and 40% water recovery .
intro: The Aquaguard Neo RO+UV 2X is an advanced 9-stage water purifier featuring NanoPore RO 2X, UV e-Boiling, and 3-in-1 Active Copper Technology. It removes microplastics, pesticides, heavy metals, bacteria, and viruses while enriching water with Copper, Calcium, and Magnesium. With a 2-year filter life, 40% water recovery, and compatibility with all water sources, it delivers safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water.
features: 9-Stage RO + UV e-Boiling Purification for complete water protection.
NanoPore RO 2X Technology removes pesticides, microplastics, lead, mercury, and industrial contaminants.
3-in-1 Active Copper Technology enriches water with Copper, Calcium, and Magnesium as per BIS norms.
2-Year Filter Life (up to 12,000 litres under standard conditions).
Mega Sediment Filter removes dust, dirt, and mud while extending filter life.
40% Water Recovery for improved water-saving performance.
Works with All Water Sources including municipal, borewell, and tanker water (TDS up to 2,000 mg/L)
